_note: Seed set of common CARC (Claim Adjustment Reason Codes) mapped to denial categories. This is NOT exhaustive — expand it as you see real denials. Full official list: https://x12.org/codes/claim-adjustment-reason-codes

4.description: The procedure code is inconsistent with the modifier used, or a required modifier is missing.

5.description: The procedure code/bill type is inconsistent with the place of service.

9.description: The diagnosis is inconsistent with the patient's age.

10.description: The diagnosis is inconsistent with the patient's gender.

11.description: The diagnosis is inconsistent with the procedure.

16.description: Claim/service lacks information or has submission/billing error(s) needed for adjudication.

22.description: This care may be covered by another payor per coordination of benefits.

23.description: The impact of prior payer(s) adjudication, including payments and/or adjustments, has been considered.

29.description: The time limit for filing has expired.

45.description: Charge exceeds fee schedule/maximum allowable or contracted/legislated fee arrangement.

49.description: This is a non-covered service because it is a routine/preventive exam or screening procedure done in conjunction with a routine exam.

50.description: These are non-covered services because this is not deemed a medical necessity by the payor.

51.description: These are non-covered services because this is a pre-existing condition.

53.description: Services by an immediate relative or a member of the same household are not covered.

55.description: Procedure/treatment/drug is deemed experimental/investigational by the payor.

56.description: Procedure/treatment has not been deemed proven to be effective by the payor.

58.description: Treatment was deemed by the payor to have been rendered in an inappropriate or invalid place of service.

59.description: Processed based on multiple or concurrent procedure rules.

60.description: Charges for outpatient services are not covered when performed within a period of time prior to or following inpatient services.

97.description: The benefit for this service is included in the payment/allowance for another service/procedure that has already been adjudicated.

109.description: Claim/service not covered by this payor/contractor — you must send the claim/service to the correct payor/contractor.

119.description: Benefit maximum for this time period or occurrence has been reached.

150.description: Payor deems the information submitted does not support this level of service.

151.description: Payor deems the information submitted does not support this many/frequency of services.

199.description: Revenue code and Procedure code do not match.

204.description: This service/equipment/drug is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan.

242.description: Services not provided by network/primary care providers.

B7.description: This provider was not certified/eligible to be paid for this procedure/service on this date of service.

B15.description: This service/procedure requires that a qualifying service/procedure be received and covered.

B20.description: Procedure/service was partially or fully furnished by another provider.
